summary: Lightning struck a group of eight hikers on the Ute Crossing Trail off Trail Ridge Road; Rebecca Teilhet, 42, of Yellow Springs, Ohio, was killed at the scene and seven others were injured
location: Ute Crossing Trail, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park rangers; air ambulance
notes: Park staff notified at 1:20 p.m. of strike on Ute Crossing Trail between Rainbow Curve and Forest Canyon Overlook. Teilhet's husband and a friend were transported by ambulance; five other hikers self-transported to Estes Park Medical Center. Air ambulance landed between severe-weather cycles.
